set -euo pipefail; echo '===TYPE==='; bash -lc 'type -a frank || true'; echo '===WRAPPER==='; ls -l ~/.local/bin/frank ~/.local/bin/frank-terminal-hilfe 2>/dev/null || true; sha256sum ~/.local/bin/frank ~/.local/bin/frank-terminal-hilfe 2>/dev/null || true; echo '---frank---'; sed -n '1,220p' ~/.local/bin/frank 2>/dev/null || true; echo '---frank-terminal-hilfe---'; sed -n '1,320p' ~/.local/bin/frank-terminal-hilfe 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===RELATED==='; find ~/.local/bin -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname 'frank*' -printf '%f
' | sort
